ast.name: desc
ast.source: Override the global setting for this choice. 'Always' forces the one-page modal even if disabled globally; 'Never' disables it even if enabled globally.

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Capture into whichever note is open when the choice runs, instead of a fixed target.
ast.target: 執行此選項時，擷取至當下開啟的筆記，而非固定目標。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Vault-relative path to a file or folder, a #tag, or property:field=value. Supports format syntax like {{DATE}}; end with '/' to capture into a folder.
ast.target: 相對於儲存庫的檔案或資料夾路徑、#標籤，或 property:field=value。支援 {{DATE}} 等格式語法；以「/」結尾可擷取至資料夾。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Choose a card from the canvas below, or paste an exact node id.
ast.target: 從下方 canvas 選擇卡片，或貼上精確的節點 ID。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Instead of typing a target line now, show a dropdown of the target note's headings when you run this capture and insert under the one you pick.
ast.target: 執行擷取時顯示目標筆記的標題下拉清單，並插入至所選標題下方，而不是現在輸入固定目標行。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Insert capture after specified text. Accepts format syntax. Tip: use a heading (starts with #) to target a section. Blank line handling is configurable below.
ast.target: 在指定文字之後插入擷取內容。可使用格式語法。提示：使用標題（以 # 開頭）可指定區段。空白行處理可在下方設定。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Replace everything after the matched text up to end-of-line.
ast.target: 取代符合文字之後到行尾的所有內容。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Place the text at the end of the matched section instead of the top.
ast.target: 將文字放在符合區段的結尾，而不是開頭。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Creates the 'insert after' line if it is not found.
ast.target: 找不到「插入於其後」的行時建立該行。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Moment format used to parse existing heading dates for sorting (e.g. YYYY-MM-DD).
ast.target: 用於解析現有標題日期以進行排序的 Moment 格式（例如 YYYY-MM-DD）。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Where to rank EXISTING headings whose text can't be parsed for this sort. (A new heading that can't be parsed is appended at the end.)
ast.target: 無法解析文字的現有標題要排在何處。（無法解析的新標題會附加在末尾。）

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Insert capture before specified text. Accepts format syntax.
ast.target: 在指定文字之前插入擷取內容。支援格式語法。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Creates the 'insert before' line if it is not found.
ast.target: 找不到「插入之前」的文字行時建立該行。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Copy a link to the captured file after the Capture choice runs.
ast.target: 擷取選項執行後，將擷取檔案的連結複製到剪貼簿。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Formats the value as a task.

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Controls whether this Capture uses the current editor selection as {{VALUE}}. Does not affect {{SELECTED}}.
ast.target: 控制此 Capture 是否使用目前編輯器選取內容作為 {{VALUE}}。不影響 {{SELECTED}}。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Get prompted to choose from both the selected folders and their subfolders when creating the note.
ast.target: 建立筆記時，從所選資料夾及其子資料夾中選擇。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Choose whether QuickAdd should ask what to do, update the existing file, create another file, or keep the existing file.
ast.target: 選擇 QuickAdd 要詢問處理方式、更新既有檔案、建立另一個檔案，或保留既有檔案。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Positive values penalize tokens by how often they already appear, reducing verbatim repetition; negative values encourage it. Only sent to providers that support it.
ast.target: 正值會依權杖已出現的頻率施加懲罰，以減少逐字重複；負值則鼓勵重複。僅傳送給支援此參數的供應商。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Positive values penalize tokens that have appeared at all, encouraging new topics; negative values do the opposite. Only sent to providers that support it.
ast.target: 正值會對曾出現過的權杖施加懲罰，以鼓勵新主題；負值則相反。僅傳送給支援此參數的供應商。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: When searching in the choice picker, also match choices nested inside folders and show their path. Note that nested matches can outrank same-level ones. Disable to search only the open level.
ast.target: 在選項挑選器中搜尋時，同時比對資料夾內的巢狀選項並顯示其路徑。請注意，巢狀結果可能排在同層結果之前。停用後只搜尋目前開啟的層級。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Use multi-line input prompt instead of single-line input prompt. Submit multi-line prompts with Ctrl/Cmd+Enter; Enter inserts a newline.
ast.target: 使用多行輸入提示取代單行提示。按 Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交多行內容；Enter 會插入換行。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Keep drafts when closing input prompts so they can be restored on reopen. Drafts are stored only for this session.
ast.target: 關閉輸入提示時保留草稿，以便重新開啟時還原。草稿只會儲存在本次工作階段。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: When enabled, Capture uses the current editor selection as {{VALUE}} and may skip the prompt. When disabled, Capture always prompts for {{VALUE}}.
ast.target: 啟用時，Capture 會使用目前編輯器選取內容作為 {{VALUE}}，並可能略過提示。停用時，Capture 一律提示輸入 {{VALUE}}。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: When on, clipboard images saved by QuickAdd (pasting into a prompt, or {{CLIPBOARD}} with an image and no text) are named after the destination note. When the destination is not yet known, QuickAdd keeps the timestamp name. Duplicate names are handled by Obsidian's attachment folder setting.
ast.target: 啟用後，QuickAdd 儲存的剪貼簿圖片（貼入輸入提示，或使用 {{CLIPBOARD}} 且剪貼簿中有圖片而無文字）會依目標筆記標題命名。若尚未確定目標筆記，QuickAdd 會保留時間戳記檔名。重複檔名會依 Obsidian 的附件資料夾設定處理。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Shortcodes for natural language date parsing. One per line: alias = phrase. Example: tm = tomorrow.
ast.target: 自然語言日期解析的短代碼。每行一個：別名 = 詞句。例如：tm = tomorrow。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: List/object values from scripts are always written as proper Obsidian properties (a list becomes a List). This toggle additionally converts string values into typed properties: a comma or bullet-list string becomes a List, "42" becomes a Number, "true" becomes a Checkbox, etc. Disabled by default; the string conversion is a beta heuristic that may have edge cases.
ast.target: 指令碼傳回的清單／物件值一律會寫成正確的 Obsidian 屬性（清單會成為「清單」）。此開關還會將字串值轉換為具型別的屬性：逗號分隔或項目符號清單字串會成為「清單」、「42」會成為「數字」、「true」會成為「核取方塊」等。預設停用；字串轉換仍是 Beta 啟發式功能，可能有邊界情況。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Display a notification when content is captured successfully to confirm the operation completed.
ast.target: 內容擷取成功時顯示通知，以確認操作已完成。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Display a notification when an input prompt is cancelled without submitting. Disable this to avoid extra notices when dismissing prompts.
ast.target: 輸入提示未送出即取消時顯示通知。停用後可避免關閉提示時出現額外通知。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: This prevents the plugin from making requests to external providers like OpenAI. You can still use user scripts to execute arbitrary code, including contacting external providers. However, this setting disables plugin features like the AI Assistant from doing so. You need to disable this setting to use the AI Assistant.
ast.target: 這會阻止外掛向 OpenAI 等外部供應商發出要求。你仍可使用使用者指令碼執行任意程式碼，包括聯絡外部供應商；但此設定會禁止 AI 助理等外掛功能這麼做。若要使用 AI 助理，必須停用此設定。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Add QuickAdd icon to the sidebar ribbon. Requires a reload.
ast.target: 將 QuickAdd 圖示加入側邊欄 ribbon。需要重新載入。

ast.name: desc
ast.target: 供開發者使用的 Git 資訊。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Read a note's full markdown content by vault path.
ast.target: 依儲存庫路徑讀取筆記的完整 Markdown 內容。

ast.name: description
ast.source: List markdown notes, optionally within a folder.
ast.target: 列出 Markdown 筆記，可選擇限定於某個資料夾。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Search notes by name and/or content. Returns matching paths with a short snippet.
ast.target: 依名稱及／或內容搜尋筆記，並傳回相符路徑與簡短片段。

ast.name: description
ast.source: List the distinct values a frontmatter property takes across the vault (e.g. existing tags or statuses).
ast.target: 列出某個 frontmatter 屬性在整個儲存庫中的不同值（例如既有標籤或狀態）。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Create a new markdown note. Fails if the path already exists.
ast.target: 建立新的 Markdown 筆記；若路徑已存在則失敗。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Append text to an existing note (frontmatter-aware for top inserts).
ast.target: 將文字附加至現有筆記（在頂端插入時會正確處理 frontmatter）。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Insert markdown under an existing heading (matched exactly). Errors if the heading is not found.
ast.target: 在現有標題下插入 Markdown（須完全相符）；找不到標題時會發生錯誤。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Get the currently active note (path, basename, and content). Returns active:null if there is none.
ast.target: 取得目前作用中的筆記（路徑、基本檔名與內容）；若沒有則傳回 active:null。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Get the current date/time. Optionally pass a moment.js format and a day offset.
ast.target: 取得目前日期／時間。可選擇傳入 moment.js 格式與日期位移量。

ast.name: description
ast.target: 相對於今天的日期位移量（例如 1 = 明天）。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Changes trailing digits only. Example: Draft009.md -> Draft010.md.
ast.target: 僅變更結尾數字。例如：Draft009.md → Draft010.md。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Keeps the original name and adds a duplicate marker. Example: Project Plan.md -> Project Plan (1).md.
ast.target: 保留原始名稱並加入副本標記。例如：Project Plan.md → Project Plan (1).md。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Leaves the file unchanged and opens the existing file.
ast.target: 不變更檔案，並開啟現有檔案。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Add text to a note — append, prepend, or insert.
ast.target: 將文字加入筆記：附加、前置或插入。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Run a sequence of commands and scripts.
ast.target: 依序執行一系列命令與指令碼。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Runs custom JavaScript with full access to your vault and the network.
ast.target: 執行可完整存取儲存庫與網路的自訂 JavaScript。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Runs custom JavaScript to decide which branch executes.
ast.target: 執行自訂 JavaScript 以決定要執行哪個分支。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Bundles a file that will be written to your vault and can be run as code.
ast.target: 封裝將寫入儲存庫且可作為程式碼執行的檔案。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Runs automatically every time Obsidian starts.
ast.target: 每次 Obsidian 啟動時自動執行。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Adds a command to the command palette.
ast.target: 將命令加入命令選擇區。

ast.name: description
ast.target: 觸發另一個 Obsidian 命令。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Sends note content to your AI provider over the network.
ast.target: 透過網路將筆記內容傳送至 AI 供應商。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Lets an AI model read and write your vault: the script gives the model tools (functions) it calls with model-chosen arguments.
ast.target: 讓 AI 模型讀寫儲存庫：指令碼會提供工具（函式），模型會以自行選擇的引數呼叫。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Writes captured text into your notes.
ast.target: 將擷取的文字寫入筆記。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Replaces a choice that already exists in your vault.
ast.target: 取代儲存庫中已存在的選項。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Overwrites a file that already exists in your vault.
ast.target: 覆寫儲存庫中已存在的檔案。

ast.name: description
ast.source: References a file that is not bundled in this package.
ast.target: 參照未封裝在此套件中的檔案。

ast.name: description
ast.source: An unrecognised command type. Review it manually.
ast.target: 無法辨識的命令類型，請手動檢查。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Opens a file in your vault.

ast.name: description
ast.source: Refresh built-in AI provider model lists: drop retired models, add the current generation, and turn on auto-sync.
ast.target: 重新整理內建 AI 供應商模型清單：移除已退役模型、加入目前世代，並開啟自動同步。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Pin AI commands' models to the provider they currently resolve to, and give every provider a stable id.
ast.target: 將 AI 命令的模型固定至目前解析到的供應商，並為每個供應商指定穩定 ID。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Note path the image will live in (capture destination). Empty keeps a vault-root attachment.
ast.target: 圖片所屬筆記的路徑（擷取目的地）。留空則將附件存放於儲存庫根目錄。

ast.name: description
